lessons.title: 现在分词、过去分词与独立主格

questions.stem: The film was so ____ that we all wanted to see it again.
questions.explain: -ing 形容词说明事物“令人……的”，-ed 形容词说明人“感到……的”。说电影“令人激动”，用 exciting。
questions.verify: 本单元按“分词与独立主格”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对。

questions.stem: We were ____ to hear that our team had won the match.
questions.explain: 人“感到高兴”用 delighted，be delighted to do sth.；delightful 意为“令人愉快的”，用来形容事物。

questions.stem: The boy ____ under the tree is my cousin.
questions.explain: 句子已有谓语 is，空格处只能用非谓语；男孩“正站着”，是主动、进行的意思，用现在分词 standing 作后置定语（= who is standing）。

questions.stem: This is the best novel ____ by that writer.
questions.explain: 小说是“被写”的，用过去分词 written 作后置定语，表示被动、完成（= which was written）。

questions.stem: ____ from the top of the hill, the town looks like a big garden.
questions.explain: 分词作状语时，它的逻辑主语就是句子的主语 the town；城镇是“被看”的，用过去分词 Seen。

questions.stem: The work ____, we went home happily.
questions.explain: The work done 是独立主格结构（名词 + 分词），work 和 do 是被动关系，用过去分词 done，相当于 After the work was done。

questions.stem: ____ no bus, we had to walk home.
questions.explain: There being no bus 是独立主格结构，表示原因（= As there was no bus）。“There was”会让两个句子之间只有逗号，缺少连词。

questions.kp: 过去分词作宾语补足语
questions.stem: When I got there, I found the door ____ (lock).
questions.explain: find + 宾语 + 宾语补足语；门是“被锁上”的，用过去分词 locked。
